power.diagnosis: 12.07 of 12.57 mW (96%) is clock power; average net toggle rate 0.0226/cycle

suggestions.title: Clock-gate rarely-written registers
suggestions.rationale: 8 register groups (7.05 mW) are clocked every cycle but toggle on <5% of cycles; their power is almost entirely clock-pin energy.
suggestions.change: synth: clockgate=on (Yosys `clockgate -liberty ... -pos sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlclkp_1 CLK GATE GCLK`); registers with an enable (edfxtp/mux feedback) become ICG-gated groups
suggestions.expected_power: up to -4.9 mW (most of the clock-pin share of these groups)
suggestions.expected_timing: neutral; ICG enable path adds a setup check

suggestions.title: Per-word write-enable clock gating of the register file
suggestions.rationale: cpuregs = 5.2269 mW (41.6% of total), 1152 flops, toggle rate 0.0002: only one 32-bit word is written per instruction.
suggestions.change:
generate one ICG per word: `sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlclkp_1 icg_i (.CLK(clk), .GATE(cpuregs_write && latched_rd==i), .GCLK(gclk[i]));`
always @(posedge gclk[i]) cpuregs[i] <= cpuregs_wrdata;
suggestions.expected_area: ~36 ICG cells added, enable muxes removed

suggestions.title: Operand isolation for the idle multiplier
suggestions.rationale: while idle (mul_waiting) the multiplier copies pcpi_rs1/pcpi_rs2 into its 64-bit rs1/rs2 shift registers and zeroes rd/rdx every cycle, even when no MUL is in flight.
suggestions.change: capture operands only on `mul_start`; otherwise hold. (The divider has the same pattern - not patched yet.)
suggestions.expected_power: less data switching in the mul datapath (clock-pin power remains until clock gating)
suggestions.verification: lint + firmware regression (RTL & gate-level); outputs cycle-exact, internal rs1/rs2/rd state differs while idle

suggestions.title: Gate upper halves of 64-bit counters
suggestions.rationale: upper 32 bits of count_cycle/count_instr change once per 2^32 increments but are clocked every cycle.
suggestions.change: split into lo/hi; `if (&lo) hi <= hi + 1;` so the hi word is enable-only (gatable)
suggestions.expected_power: small now (adder switching); large once clock gating is on (hi word becomes enable-only)

timing.diagnosis: WNS -0.982 ns / TNS -3.0 ns, 6/4104 endpoints failing, Fmax 91.1 MHz

suggestions.title: Parallel-prefix adder for the PC/immediate adder
suggestions.rationale: critical path irq_state[0] -> reg_next_pc[30] has slack -0.982 ns, depth 34: ripple-carry adder chain (9 carry cells in series).
suggestions.change: synth: adder=kogge-stone (or sklansky) via Yosys `techmap -map +/choices/kogge-stone.v` before abc
suggestions.expected_timing: recover the 0.98 ns deficit; 32-bit KS ~= 6-7 levels vs 32

suggestions.title: Precompute branch/jump target one state earlier
suggestions.rationale: reg_pc + decoded_imm and the next-PC mux are evaluated in the same cycle as their use; both operands are stable from decode.
suggestions.change: add `reg [31:0] pc_plus_imm; always @(posedge clk) pc_plus_imm <= reg_pc + decoded_imm;` in the fetch/decode state and use it in cpu_state_exec
suggestions.expected_timing: removes the adder from the exec-cycle reg_out path
suggestions.verification: lint + firmware regression (RTL & gate-level) + STA; cycle-exact at the ports

suggestions.title: Try TWO_CYCLE_ALU / TWO_CYCLE_COMPARE
suggestions.rationale: the ALU result path is near-critical (alu_out_q) and shares the operand muxes.
suggestions.expected_timing: cuts ALU/compare paths; CPI rises slightly
suggestions.verification: lint + firmware regression (RTL & gate-level); cycle count may change

congestion.diagnosis: pre-placement proxy: 37,525 pins over 110,199 um2 cell area (avg 0.34 pins/um2); largest cone reg_out = 23% of all pins

suggestions.title: Decouple the register-file read mux from the ALU operand cones
suggestions.rationale: the largest cones (reg_out, pcpi_mul.pcpi_rs1, timer) each hold ~2k cells and ~2x the design-average pin density - they share the 36:1 cpuregs read mux plus the ALU.
suggestions.change: register the read data (`reg_op1/reg_op2` from a dedicated read stage) or enable ENABLE_REGS_DUALPORT=1 so rs1/rs2 reads are separate, narrower muxes
suggestions.verification: lint + firmware regression (RTL & gate-level); cycle count may change

suggestions.title: Replicate / pipeline high-fanout control nets
suggestions.rationale: resetn: max fanout 583 on one bit (1 bits, 583 sinks total); pcpi_mul.mul_waiting: max fanout 237 on one bit (1 bits, 237 sinks total); pcpi_mul.rs1: max fanout 127 on one bit (1 bits, 127 sinks total)
suggestions.change: resetn: synchronise once and fan out from a buffered reset tree (or drop reset on datapath flops that do not need it); mul_waiting/cpu_state: one-hot decode registered per consumer group
suggestions.expected_timing: removes buffer chains on control nets
